svg.aria-label: What runs where. In the browser, the React pages and stores talk to the server over HTTPS and over the lv.1 WebSocket, and keep two peer connections: one that publishes and one that receives. The server is one Go process: net/http serves the page and the API, gnet carries signalling to the presence hub with one actor per room, and the hub drives the Pion SFU. Media goes from the publishing connection to the SFU and from the SFU to the receiving connections over UDP with DTLS-SRTP.
